The #1 Premium Elementor Widget Library for Creating Professional Websites

Spider Elements is the most comprehensive Elementor addons collection, featuring 24+ powerful widgets to transform your website design. Perfect for agencies, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and web designers who want stunning results without coding.

Essential Tools for Web Designers & Developers

Spider Elements provides the widgets you need to build professional websites faster. From blogs to testimonials, timelines to image galleries, every widget is crafted for maximum usability and visual impact.

Core Widgets Available (Free Version)

Content & Layout Widgets
– Accordion – Organize and manage content with smooth collapsible sections, perfect for FAQs, guides, and comprehensive resource documentation. Enhance user experience with elegant accordion functionality.
– Blog Grid – Display your WordPress posts beautifully with multiple customizable layouts, built-in pagination, and responsive design. Perfect for showcasing blog content across all devices.
– Timeline – Show important events and milestones in chronological order with an intuitive visual timeline. Ideal for company history, project phases, and journey storytelling.
– List Items – Create organized, stylish lists with custom icons and detailed descriptions. Perfect for services, features, advantages, and organized content presentation.
– Icon Box – Highlight key features and services with eye-catching custom icons and compelling text. Great for showcasing features, benefits, and value propositions elegantly.

Visual & Media Widgets
– Video Popup – Embed videos in sleek, professional pop-up windows without page reload. Enhance user engagement with smooth video experiences and modal presentation.
– Team Carousel – Showcase team members in dynamic, interactive carousels with smooth transitions. Perfect for displaying staff, employees, and team introductions professionally.
– Testimonials – Display customer reviews, feedback, and success stories in elegant, responsive designs. Build trust with visitor testimonials and compelling social proof.
– Counter – Animate impressive statistics and achievement numbers with engaging visual effects. Perfect for displaying metrics, achievements, and impressive business accomplishments.
– Integrations – Highlight compatible tools, platforms, and partner integrations with professional styling. Showcase technology partnerships and supported services effectively.

Premium Widgets (Pro Version)

Interactive & Animation Widgets
– Box Hover – Add stylish hover effects with smooth animations and transitions. Enhance user engagement and interactivity with professional animation effects.
– Flip Box – Create dynamic flip effects that reveal hidden content on interaction. Perfect for showcasing before-after, features, or additional information creatively.
– Image Hover – Bring images to life with engaging and professional hover effects. Perfect for portfolios, galleries, and visual content enhancement.
– Feature Box – Showcase key features and services in attention-grabbing layouts. Ideal for highlighting product features and service benefits prominently.
– Hotspot – Add interactive points on images to highlight details and provide information. Great for product demos, educational content, and interactive presentations.

Advanced Content Widgets
– Image Slider – Create beautiful, responsive image slideshows with smooth transitions. Perfect for galleries, portfolios, and showcasing multiple images effectively.
– Video Playlist – Organize and play multiple videos in an interactive playlist. Ideal for tutorials, video content libraries, and multimedia presentations.
– Marquee Slider – Display scrolling content in visually appealing ways with continuous movement. Perfect for announcements, testimonials, and dynamic content display.
– Stack Image – Display images in creative stacked layouts with impressive visual effects. Great for before-after comparisons and artistic image presentations.
– Cheat Sheet – Create quick reference guides and cheat sheets for easy navigation. Perfect for organizing complex information in an accessible format.
– Skill Showcase – Highlight skills, services, and expertise with sleek professional designs. Ideal for portfolios, resumes, and professional showcases.
– Accordion Articles – Advanced collapsible content organization for complex articles. Perfect for organizing extensive content with improved readability.
– Tabs – Keep content organized with tabbed navigation and smooth transitions. Ideal for organizing information into manageable, interactive sections.
– Alerts Box – Display important announcements with custom styling and visual emphasis. Perfect for alerts, notices, messages, and urgent information display.

Quick Features Overview

User-Friendly Design
– Intuitive controls and settings
– Real-time preview while editing
– Drag-and-drop simplicity

Performance Optimized

– Optimized for all devices

Developer Friendly

– Regular updates and support

  3. Search for “Spider Elements” in the widget panel
  4. Drag widgets onto your page
  5. Customize with live preview

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.4 or higher
– Elementor 3.0.0 or higher
– MySQL 5.6 or higher

Recommended
– PHP 8.0 or higher for best performance
– WordPress memory limit of 256 MB or higher

Installation Steps

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Spider Elements”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate
  4. Open any page with Elementor
  5. Search for “Spider Elements” in the widget panel
  6. Start dragging widgets to your page

Alternative: Manual Installation

  1. Download the spider-elements.zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Select and upload the spider-elements.zip file
  4. Click Activate Plugin
  5. Start using Spider Elements widgets in Elementor

After installation, you’ll see a “Spider Elements” category in your Elementor widget panel with all available widgets.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use Spider Elements?

Yes, Elementor is required. Spider Elements is an addon plugin that works exclusively with Elementor (both free and Pro versions).

Will Spider Elements work with my WordPress theme?

Absolutely! Spider Elements works with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor, including Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, and all other standard themes.

Is Spider Elements compatible with Elementor Pro?

Yes, it’s fully compatible with both Elementor free and Elementor Pro versions.

Can I use Spider Elements widgets on all pages?

Yes! You can use Spider Elements widgets on any page, post, or custom post type that Elementor supports.

How many widgets does Spider Elements include?

Spider Elements includes 10+ widgets in the free version and 24+ total widgets in the Pro version.

Are there preset designs for the widgets?

Yes! Each widget includes multiple preset designs that you can customize further using the live editor.

Do I need to know how to code to use Spider Elements?

No! Spider Elements is completely beginner-friendly. Everything can be done through the visual Elementor editor with drag-and-drop functionality.

Is Spider Elements mobile responsive?

Yes, all widgets are fully responsive and optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

How often is Spider Elements updated?

We release regular updates with new features, improvements, and bug fixes. You’ll receive updates automatically.

Why is the Elementor editor not loading?

This is usually a server PHP memory issue. Try increasing your PHP memory limit to 512MB in wp-config.php or contact your hosting provider to increase:
* PHP memory limit = 512M
* max_execution_time = 300

Where can I get support?

Visit our Documentation or check our Demo & Tutorials.

Can I get a refund if I’m not satisfied?

Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on Pro purchases.

What’s included in the Pro version?

The Pro version includes 14+ additional premium widgets plus advanced features and priority support.
